en: "And to think I had you and Kathleen right here...{w}I should have trusted you both and come to you for advice.{w}...And thank you too, all of you."{w}
note: [JP] = Soara (she spoke the row before); [JP] = Mirco's group, who answer next. | Editorial: "I had you, and Kathleen as well" lost the regretful concession of ...[JP]; now "And to think I had you and Kathleen right here".

en: "You're welcome."{w}
"But why do you have the same dark...{w}...No, that would be tactless of me.{w}For now, I'll simply be grateful for your help."{w}
note: [JP]...: cut off; read as Mirco's group sharing the darkness of the Kin of Darkness they fought (Baltagias just awoke as a dark blade). Kept vague. | Accuracy: source asks why the group has (something) of the same darkness, cut off at [JP]; the draft turned the darkness into a relative clause and implied a different question. Now the darkness is the content of the question, cut off mid-phrase.

en: "Hehe~{w}...Guess it's about time we headed out."{w}
note: Editorial: Mirco's [JP] = "Hehe" as in slice 055 (3554/3556).

en: "Huh? We're going already?"{w}
note: Elpina is in Mirco's party, so "we" for the unstated subject of [JP].

en: "Yeah.{w}We stopped Zoze, and that's good enough."{w}
"Well then, until we meet again."{w}
"Bye-byeee!"{w}
Mirco and the others left.{w}
Not everything had been resolved.{w}{p}But the great threat had passed, and Rubenburg was able to regain its old atmosphere.{w}

"Thank you too, everyone.{w}Now there's nothing left weighing on me either.{w}...Maybe I'll go back. To Bistel."{w}{p}"I think I'll stay here a little while longer, so if anything comes up, come see me on 1F.{w}See you!"{w}
note: [JP] = the player party. 1[JP] -> "1F".

en:
"You, too, should beware of 'knowing too much.'{w}Don't go gaining more knowledge than you can handle
and end up being led around by it."{w}
note: [JP] -> single quotes per brief. | Accuracy: [JP] = more knowledge than one can handle; "beyond your station" implied social rank.

en:
{0E}*    The way is lit not by light alone.    *
*                                          *
*  At thy feet, and further still beyond,  *{0F}{w}{p}{0E}*  a deadly darkness shall show the way.   *
*       Those who grasp its meaning        *
*      shall walk on and never fall.       *{0F}{w}
note: Stone inscription with * borders (source [JP]). Centred with spaces; proportional font, so the right border will not align exactly: check in game. Dungeon hint (dark zone ahead / pits).

en: The Holy Ember is burning a bright red.{w}
note: Holy Ember (glossary).

en: Rogorn
"Myyy...{w}luuucky baaags...{w}wanna buuuy one?"{w}
note: [JP] = slurred [JP]; drawn-out rustic speech kept with stretched vowels.

en: Buy a lucky bag?
"Much obliiiged..."{w}
"Seeee ya..."{w}

note: [JP] = the unidentified bag contents; price insert kept.

"Gwoooaaargh...{w}Ah... Aaaaaahhh...{w}It's HOOOT, can't you tell!!"{w}{p}"What do those guys underground think they're doing!!{w}Sure, it's called the Scorching Castle,
but there's such a thing as limits, y'knooow!!"{w}{p}"Listen up, you lot!{w}Clean out your ears and listen good!!{w}I may be the Fire Sage, but I ain't a fire spirit!"{w}{p}"Hot is HOT, okay!!"{w}{p}"Aaaah... This is bad...{w}I might seriously die..."{w}{p}"...Okay, got it. Here's the plan.{w}You, go on down underground for a bit.{w}Go make those spirits settle down for me."{w}{p}"I'm counting on you!!"{w}
note: [JP] = the player party, addressed as one ("You").

en: Radrecht's giant foot slowly drew back.{w}And then...{w}
note: [JP]: wind-up for a kick (the party gets sent below); kept as the source shows it. | Proofread: past tense, as in the rest of the slice narration.

en: "Heeeey!!{w}The heat hasn't changed one bit!!{w}Do it over, you idiots!!"{w}
note: [JP] at the party: "you idiots".

en: "Whew, it's finally back to normal, all because of you guys.{w}Thanks a bunch!"{w}
note: Editorial: avoid "thanks ... Thanks" back to back; [JP] -> "all because of you guys".
[JP] -> "sweet Shirinmorin" (no -chan in the corpus). Shirinmorin is female per glossary.

en: Radrecht started writing a love letter...{w}

"All right, done!{w}...But it takes guts to hand it over, huh..."{w}{p}"This...{w}Could you take it to sweet Shirinmorin for me?"{w}{p}"Please, I'm begging you! I'll make it worth your while!{w}C'mon!{w}You'll do it, right!?"{w}
note: [JP] (bowing gesture) -> "I'm begging you"; [JP] -> "I'll make it worth your while".

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained the Fire Sage's Love Letter.{w}
note: New item name "Fire Sage's Love Letter" (eboot eb@08950738 still untranslated).

en: "I'm counting on you guys!!"{w}
"Dammit! I'm getting nervous!!{w}What kind of answer am I gonna get...!!"{w}
"H-how'd it go? How'd it go, huh!?"{w}
You told Radrecht how it went when you handed it over.{w}
note: Listener (Radrecht) named for clarity; the source leaves it implied by the scene.

en: "S... seriously...{w}Sh-she didn't have to tear it uuup...{w}Sure, the answer's just what I figured, but..."{w}{p}"Oh man, I think I'm... gonna cry..."{w}
note: [JP] read as the reply being what Radrecht expected. | Accuracy: Shirinmorin tore the letter (slice 048 SCD10:3077); "you" read as the party tearing it. She = female per glossary. | Proofread: stutter lowercase after ellipsis (corpus majority, e.g. 057 Th... then).

en: Comfort Radrecht?
note: Object named instead of a pronoun (Radrecht's gender unknown).

en: "Sniff... You guys are good people...{w}Thanks, I feel a little better."{w}{p}"Oh yeah, take this with you.{w}It's my thanks for putting up with all my crazy requests."{w}
"Come by and hang out anytime, y'hear!{w}I'll be waiting!!"{w}
"If a letter's no good, what should I try next?{w}...I know, I'll write a song!!{w}Girls love songs and stuff, right! Alllright!!"{w}
It seems it would be hard to unlock from this side.{w}
note: Editorial: removed the clumsy "this ... this side".

en: Ifrit

"Radrecht is furious...{w}You lot had better not get too close
to Radrecht right now..."{w}
note: [JP] -> "Radrecht" (no Lord/Lady: gender not established).

en: "Looks like things underground have finally calmed down."{w}
"Radrecht, together with the rest of the Four Sages..."{w}
note: Deliberately trails off, kept unfinished. | Editorial: "the other Four Sages" implied four others; Radrecht is one of the four.

en: "Hey, take my advice...{w}Leave this castle quietly!{w}Fire Sage Radrecht's rage is in top form!"{w}
note: [JP] kept as the comic "in top form".

en: "Honestly, the Queen is such a headache."{w}
note: [JP] = the Phoenix Queen.

en: "...So Radrecht has gone, then."{w}
"Complain about the heat all you want, but..."{w}
"That thing underground was a three-way fight, right?{w}Who won in the end? Who? Who?"{w}
"An old promise, huh..."{w}
Referee

"The fire kin's Spirit Tournament
will be held shortly.{w}Entries are now open to any spirit wishing to compete!"{w}
note: [JP] -> "the fire kin" ([JP] = Kin, as in Kin of Darkness). | Editorial: fronted "Shortly" and the dangling "Spirits wishing to compete, entries are..." fixed; "the fire kin's Spirit Tournament" as in slice 060 (3134).

en:
"We now open the Scorching Castle
Fire Spirit Tournament!{w}First, the competitors make their entrance. Please welcome them with a round of applause!"{w}
note: Editorial: "take the floor" (= begin speaking) replaced by "make their entrance" for [JP].

en: "Our first contestant: the Fire Elemental!{w}Small, but packs some heat!{w}Fighting to raise the standing of Elementals!"{w}
note: [JP]: play on the proverb "small but spicy"; rendered "Small, but packs some heat". | Editorial: dropped "everywhere" (not in the source; flagged by accuracy).

en: "Nobody's gonna call me a little spark anymore!!"{w}
note: [JP] here = "spark" (also in 3034); not the Holy Ember item.

en: "Next up, an undisputed powerhouse!{w}When you say Mister Fire, you mean this one!{w}The incarnation of flame, Ifrit!!"{w}
note: [JP] kept as "Mister Fire" (source title).

en: "Yours truly is No. 1! Number One!"{w}
note: [JP] -> "Yours truly"; Number One per glossary.

en: "And now, last of all, the champion of the previous Spirit Tournament!{w}The Queen of Fire, with grace and power alike!{w}The Phoenix Queen"{w}
note: [JP] here and again in 3029 (source says "last" twice, a joke); kept both. Source has no ! after the name; none added.

en: Phoenix Queen
"Oh-ho-ho-ho!!"{w}
"And the very last of all: a walk-on entry!{w}The nameless adventurerrrs!!"{w}
note: Editorial: "at the very last" is not idiomatic; keeps the second "last" joke after 3025.

en: For some reason, you've been entered!!{w}

"Perhaps due to the anomaly at the Holy Foundation, Contrachio,
the spirits are all worked up this term!{w}With the heat still running high, the tournament now begins!!"{w}
"Every great blaze starts from a tiny spark!{w}Fire Elemental, here I am!!"{w}
"Number One!{w}Number Ooooone!!"{w}
"Oh-ho-ho-ho!!{w}Fire kin or not, I shall turn you all to ash!!"{w}
"Ready... FIGHT!!"{w}
You sent them all flying.{w}
"The winner: the nameless adventurerrrs!!"{w}
"N-no waaay..."{w}
"N-Number Two..."{w}
"Aaaagh!{w}How could I, of all people, lose!?"{w}
note: [JP] = shriek of frustration; [JP] (affected posh "I") -> "I, of all people".
